paragraphs.text: As God by his power and wisdom has made and governed the world, so must the same be our defence against all enemies and dangers.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: In which you sit and govern the world.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: God's power appears in ruling the furious waters.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Besides God's power and wisdom in creating and governing his great mercy also appears in that he has given his people his word and covenant.
paragraphs.label: d
